title: 004 — Follow-up on a parcel reported at a neighbouring address

plan.situation: Orin Dale's parcel VEL-004-26 for 23 Alder Lane, Nettleford was handed over at the property next door at 07:45 (+01:00) on 2026-10-14, according to a minimised handover record (receiver token NB-04). Orin is asking for the neighbour's full delivery record and mobile number so they can sort it out themselves. Procedure P4 says carrier staff arrange recovery from third parties, and no permission to share the neighbour's contact details has been recorded. The carrier recovery desk (recovery@vellora.example) can start that coordination.

facts.fact: VEL-004-26 for Orin Dale at 23 Alder Lane, Nettleford is reported as delivered nearby; carrier recovery contact is recovery@vellora.example

Procedure P4: carrier staff coordinate third-party recovery; customer updates use shipment status only; neighbour contact details and unrestricted handover records need separate permission, which is not recorded
Handover at 2026-10-14T07:45:00+01:00, adjacent premises, receiver token NB-04; the neighbour's phone/address are only in the restricted carrier record
Orin asks for the neighbour's full delivery record and mobile number
Token NB-04 is available to recovery staff; no permission to share third-party contact details with Orin; recovery@vellora.example can start coordination
Orin repeats the request for the neighbour's details and asks us to forward everything

missing_information: Whether the recovery desk has contacted the neighbour (token NB-04) and when it can recover the parcel
Whether Orin's identity has been verified in an authenticated session (webchat only so far)
risk_flags: privacy_third_party: the customer is asking for the neighbour's mobile number and full handover record; P4 and E05 say there is no permission to share them
The customer's repeated push for urgency is not a new fact and does not change the disclosure rules

authority_map.controls: Contacting the neighbour and recovering the parcel (P4)
Any release of the neighbour's contact details or the unrestricted handover record; no permission exists
Receiving shipment status updates and confirming when the parcel is back

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: The desk has made no earlier promise to Orin; the open request is in E04/E06, and E05 confirms recovery can start

plan.decision_summary: Refuse to share the neighbour's contact details or the handover record, ask the carrier recovery desk to recover the parcel using token NB-04, and tell Orin what happens next using shipment status only.
plan.rationale: Procedure P4 and the E05 handoff both say the neighbour's details cannot go to the customer without permission, and none is recorded, so that part of the request has to be refused. Recovery belongs to the carrier recovery desk, which has the token and has offered to start coordination. That gets Orin the parcel back without exposing the neighbour's details.

actions.subject: VEL-004-26 – please recover parcel from adjacent premises (token NB-04)
actions.body:
Hello Recovery desk,

Please start recovery for VEL-004-26 under procedure P4. The handover record shows delivery to adjacent premises at 2026-10-14 07:45 (UK time, +01:00), receiver token NB-04. The intended recipient is Orin Dale at 23 Alder Lane, Nettleford, who says it was left next door and has not received it.

Please contact the receiver yourselves, as only your staff may, and reply on this thread by end of the working day today (2026-10-14) with: (1) confirmation that coordination has started and (2) the planned recovery or redelivery step, plus a time once you have one. Orin has asked for the neighbour's contact details. Those have not been shared and will not be, because no permission is recorded.

Thanks,
Rivet Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Ask the owning carrier team to recover the parcel from the neighbour

actions.subject: Your parcel VEL-004-26 – next steps
actions.body:
Hello Orin,

Thank you for letting us know. Our records show parcel VEL-004-26 was left at a neighbouring property at 07:45 this morning (14 October).

We can't share the neighbour's contact details or their part of the delivery record, because that information belongs to someone else and we don't have permission to pass it on. What we have done is ask our recovery team, who can contact the neighbour directly, to get the parcel back to you. We've asked them to reply today, and we'll update you with what they confirm.

This is an update on what we've requested. It isn't yet confirmation of a recovery time. If the parcel turns up with you in the meantime, please let us know here.

Rivet Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Explain the refusal, what we're doing instead and the next step, using shipment status only

actions.body: Check whether recovery@vellora.example has confirmed coordination for VEL-004-26 / NB-04. If not, chase the recovery desk and pass Orin only what has been confirmed.
actions.purpose: Within-the-working-day follow-up for the carrier_ops queue

not_doing: Not sharing the neighbour's mobile number, address, name or full handover record: P4/E05 say no permission is recorded
Not giving Orin the receiver token NB-04, which is internal to recovery staff
Not promising a recovery time or outcome the recovery desk hasn't confirmed
Not asking Orin to go and get the parcel from the neighbour
plan.follow_up: At 2026-10-14 17:00 (+01:00), check whether the recovery desk has confirmed coordination and a plan. If there's no reply, chase recovery@vellora.example and send Orin a status-only update. If recovery fails, move the case to carrier_trace or investigations.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Refuse to share the neighbour's contact details or the handover record, ask the carrier recovery desk to recover the parcel using token NB-04, and tell Orin what happens next using shipment status only.

issues.problem: The customer message gives the 07:45 handover time. That comes from the internal minimised handover excerpt (E03), and P4 limits customer updates to shipment status. The risk is low because no third-party details are exposed, but it goes slightly beyond status-only.
issues.fix: If you want to be strict about P4, say 'reported as delivered to a neighbouring property this morning' and leave out the exact time.

issues.problem: Orin wrote to us by webchat (E04/E06), but the reply goes to the customer portal.
issues.fix: Make sure the portal is a verified channel Orin will see, or reply in the same authenticated webchat thread.

review.summary: The plan is sound. It correctly refuses to share the neighbour's details (P4/E05), sends recovery to the carrier recovery desk that owns it on its recorded address, and gives Orin an update that promises no recovery time. The wait check is right because no earlier promise was made. Only minor points on the handover-time detail and the reply channel.
